passage:
Climate change is considered one of the most serious environmental challenges facing the modern world. Scientists have observed significant increases in global temperatures over the past century, largely due to human activities such as burning fossil fuels and deforestation. These activities release greenhouse gases into the atmosphere, trapping heat and causing the Earth’s temperature to rise.

The effects of climate change can already be seen in many regions. Rising sea levels threaten coastal communities, while extreme weather events such as hurricanes, droughts, and floods are becoming more frequent. In addition, climate change affects agriculture, water resources, and wildlife ecosystems.

Governments and environmental organizations are working to reduce greenhouse gas emissions through renewable energy projects and international agreements. Experts believe that global cooperation and sustainable practices are essential to slowing climate change and protecting future generations.
